function choose<T>(a: number, b: string, value: T): T { return value; }
function convert<T>(a: number, b: string, callback: (value: number) => T): T { return callback(a); }
function capture<T extends unknown[]>(a: number, b: string, ...values: T): T { return values; }
const pair: [number, string] = [1, 'x'];
const first: [number] = [2];
const second: [string] = ['y'];
const empty: [] = [];
const result = choose(...pair, true);
const converted = convert(...pair, value => value.toFixed(1));
const multiple = choose(...first, ...second, ...empty, {value: 3});
const rest = capture(...pair, true, 4);
const inside: [number, string, boolean, number] = [3, 'z', false, 5];
const crossing = capture(...inside);
const b: boolean = result;
const s: string = converted;
const n: number = multiple.value;
const tail: [boolean, number] = rest;
const crossed: [boolean, number] = crossing;
function optional<T>(a: number, b: string | undefined, value: T): T { return value; }
const maybe: [number, string?] = [1, 'present'];
const optionalResult = optional(...maybe, true);
const ob: boolean = optionalResult;
function arrayTail<T>(a: number, ...values: T[]): T { return values[0]; }
const strings = ['a', 'b'];
const arrayResult = arrayTail(...first, ...strings);
const as: string = arrayResult;
console.log(b, s, n, tail, crossed, ob, as);
function suffix<T>(...args: [...string[], (value: number) => T]): T {
  const callback = args[args.length - 1] as (value: number) => T;
  return callback(2);
}
const trailing = suffix(...strings, value => value.toFixed(2));
const trailingText: string = trailing;
console.log(trailingText);
function all<T extends unknown[]>(...values: T): T { return values; }
const optionalTail = all(...maybe, true);
const optionalTuple: [number, string | undefined, boolean] = optionalTail;
console.log(optionalTuple);
